source: live PySpark 4.1.2 + iceberg-spark-runtime-4.1_2.13:1.11.0, InMemoryCatalog `sc`, 2026-09-24; probe drivers target/probe-u7-pr1/probe.py, probe2.py, probe3.py (U7 PR1 step 1); recorded cells from the 2026-09-24 scoreboard spark-core.json; round-2 fix probes target/probe-u7-r1fix/sprobe.py and sprobe2.py (same Spark and Iceberg, 2026-09-24) re-measured ctas_part_upper and create_part_upper with the `# Partition Information` rows (`partition_info`) and added the shapes from bucketBy_new_missing_col_overwrite to ctas_clustered_colname; `<root>` stands for that probe directory; round-3 fix probe target/probe-u7-r2fix/sprobe.py (same Spark and Iceberg, 2026-09-24) added bucketBy_new_nested_col, bucketBy_new_nested_missing and bucketBy_new_dotted_missing (Spark backtick-quotes a bucket column name containing '.', and only that; sprobe.out and sprobe2.out hold the other name shapes), spec_id_current_then_absent, bucket_existing_void_append (a format-version 1 table whose dropped field became void) and bucket_existing_time_append; the nested frame is createDataFrame with the DDL `id BIGINT, s STRUCT<a: INT, b: STRING>`; round-4 fix probe target/probe-u7-r3fix/sprobe.py (same Spark and Iceberg, 2026-09-24) added sortBy_missing, sortBy_dotted_missing, sortBy_second_missing, sortBy_missing_overwrite and sortBy_bucket_missing_first (a sortBy column the frame lacks is the same 3060 as a bucket column, the bucket columns named first; no table is left behind); U7 PR2 (2026-09-24): target/probe-u7-pr2/record.py recorded the sat_*, *_option_branch_*, v2_option_tag_append, v2_options_branch_upper, oc_* and vf_* shapes (a vf_* shape takes validate-from-snapshot-id from the seed snapshot and applies its change before the overwrite; `#<id>` stands for a Spark attribute id) (seed `values` = one INSERT VALUES, `named` = INSERT … UNION ALL, three files; `schema`/`refs`/`history` (snapshot indexes in commit order)/`properties`/`format_version`/`sort_fields`/`uuid_same`/`branch_rows` read after the write; an AnalysisException message stops before Spark's appended plan); recorded cells W-DF-SAVEASTABLE-OVERWRITE, W-DF-V2-OPTION-BRANCH, W-DF-V2-OVERWRITE-COND-PART and W-DF-V2-OVERWRITE-COND-ROWS from the same scoreboard file. U7 PR2 slice-1 round 2 (2026-09-25): target/probe-u7-pr2a-r1fix/record_ids.py re-recorded the slice-1 shapes with the current schema's field ids by name (`field_ids`, nested struct/list/map ids included), `identifier_field_ids`, `last_column_id`, `current_schema_id`, `schema_ids`, the default spec's `spec_fields` (source id, field id, name, transform) and the sorted `spec_ids` (every earlier value unchanged), and added the ids_* shapes (reordered, swapped, renamed, added, dropped, type-changed, nested-reordered, identifier, reordered partitionBy and re-added columns, each reading branch b1 where it has one), sat_overwrite_dynamic_option, v1_option_branch_overwrite, v1_option_branch_insert_into_overwrite and sat_overwrite_partby_on_partitioned; the SparkException text of ids_type_change_branch keeps only its ClassCastException clause. U7 PR2 slice-1 round 3 (2026-09-25): target/probe-u7-pr2a-r2fix/record_doors.py recorded the five replace doors with the same observations and a branch b1 read: sql_column_def_replace, sql_replace_table, sql_rtas_reordered, v2_create_or_replace_reordered and v2_replace_renamed (the critic's r2 probe /tmp/xr-xu7-writedf-probe/spark.json measured the same branch rows and ids). U7 PR2 slice-2 rebase (2026-09-25): the oc_*, vf_* and v2_option_branch_overwrite_condition shapes re-recorded through record.py's shapes under a recorder adding the same field-id observations (every earlier value unchanged). U7 PR2 slice-2 round 2 (2026-09-25, critic V-001/V-003/V-004): the scratchpad recorder xr/xrec2.py (record.py's session and state plus the field-id observations, same Spark and Iceberg, JDK 17) added oc_between_fractional, oc_le_fractional, oc_isin_rows, oc_data_string_rows, oc_startswith_partition, oc_isnull_with_null_row, oc_not_partition_with_null_row and oc_not_in_with_null_row (the last three insert a fourth row (4, 'd', NULL) before the overwrite), oc_lit_null, oc_frame_upper_case, oc_cond_on_dropped_frame_column, oc_nested_field (the ids_nested_reorder_branch seed `nested` and the frame [(7, {9, g}), (8, {1, h})]), vf_bad_id_no_level, vf_bad_id_level_none, vf_unknown_id_no_level, vf_empty_table_validate, oc_branch_target (writeTo('t.branch_b1'), branch_rows read after), vf_on_branch_target (a DELETE on the branch after the validation start), oc_extra_and_missing_bigint, oc_extra_and_missing_string and oc_extra_and_missing_reordered.
